name: com.igp.custom-unity-cli
description: Static declaration of the cucli surface. The 'offline' section is served by Tools/cucli.ps1 itself. Editor groups live in commands/modules/*.json (one shard per Editor/Commands folder) and are generated from the compiled worker by 'cucli commands export' so that 'cucli commands list' works even while Unity is closed. Project-local commands are deliberately NOT written here: they go to registry.local.json inside the project's extension area, outside this package.

offline.name: project
offline.summary: Report where the CLI thinks the project is, its Unity version and whether the worker is alive.

actions.name: show
actions.summary: Project root, Unity version, package root and worker status.

offline.name: status
offline.summary: Worker heartbeat, queue depths and which catalog is in use.

actions.name: show
actions.summary: Combined worker and queue status.

offline.name: doctor
offline.summary: Diagnose the project, package, worker, Unity install and static/runtime registry drift.

actions.name: check
actions.summary: Static checks only; never starts Unity.

actions.name: deep
actions.summary: Adds a full CLI -> queue -> Editor -> result round trip.

offline.name: logs
offline.summary: Tail a log source without starting Unity.

actions.name: game
actions.summary: Tail <project>/log.txt.

actions.name: cli
actions.summary: Tail the CLI's own ndjson log.

actions.name: console
actions.summary: Tail the captured Editor console as ndjson.

offline.name: commands
offline.summary: Inspect the command catalog and refresh the static registry.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List every group with its actions and safety metadata.

actions.name: describe
actions.summary: Show one group's full declaration, including its parameter schema.

actions.name: groups
actions.summary: Print group names only.

actions.name: export
actions.summary: Regenerate commands/registry.json from the compiled worker (requires Unity).

offline.name: job
offline.summary: Inspect and control queued Editor work.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List recent jobs grouped by queue state.

actions.name: status
actions.summary: Show one job's queue state and result if terminal.

actions.name: wait
actions.summary: Block until a job reaches a terminal state.

actions.name: result
actions.summary: Print a finished job's result payload.

actions.name: cancel
actions.summary: Request cancellation at the next step boundary.

actions.name: clean
actions.summary: Delete terminal job files.

offline.name: open
offline.summary: Launch Unity for this project, preferring an already-running Unity Hub instance.

actions.name: start
actions.summary: Launch Unity; optionally wait for the worker to come up.

offline.name: extend
offline.summary: The project-local extension area, where this project grows its own command groups. Never published with the package.

actions.name: path
actions.summary: Print the extension root, its manifest and its local registry path.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List the extension folder, its source files and the project-local command groups.

actions.name: init
actions.summary: Create the extension folder with its manifest and README. Works with Unity closed.

offline.name: version
offline.summary: Print CLI, package and PowerShell versions.

actions.name: show
actions.summary: Version summary.
